headline: United States Reportedly Opts Not to Extend USMCA, Threatening North American Trade and Supply Chains
summary: The reported decision by the United States not to extend the USMCA agreement signifies a major regulatory shift and trade war escalation, posing immense disruption to integrated North American supply chains. This move has significant geopolitical implications, potentially fracturing economic relations with Canada and Mexico and introducing widespread uncertainty for industries reliant on the regional trade bloc.
